timeout.description: Seconds to wait before automatically booting the default OS. Set to 0 for instant boot, -1 for no timeout.

show_advanced.description: When true, show advanced boot options like kernel parameters, fallback boot, etc.

sound.description: Enable UI sound effects (beeps) for navigation.

scan_for.description: List of boot types to scan for. Common values: C (UEFI OS installers), H (internal hard disks), S (removable drives), U (USB/external), M (macOS), N (network/PXE).

ignore_uuids.description: List of volume UUIDs to ignore during scanning (to prevent booting into unwanted OSes).

theme_path.description: Path (relative to ESP root or absolute) to a theme directory. Leave empty to disable theming.

icons.description: Icon file formats to load (e.g., icns, png) — usually auto-detected by rEFInd, but this can override.

hide_entries.description: List of boot entry names, labels, or UUIDs to hide from the menu. Supports wildcards and regex-like substrings.

default_selection.description: Boot entry to select by default — specify by label, index (e.g., '2'), or UUID. Empty means auto-select first visible.

enable_legacy_bios.description: Enable legacy BIOS compatibility (for hybrid MBR/UEFI setups). If true, adds 'H' to ScanFor.

extra_kernel_options.description: Additional kernel command-line arguments to append to every Linux boot entry (e.g., 'splash', 'quiet', 'acpi=force').

shell_enabled.description: Enable scanning for UEFI shell (e.g., Shell.efi) in the ESP root or subdirs. Adds 'SH' to ScanFor.

secure_boot.description: Enable UEFI Secure Boot mode. Requires signed binaries and proper signing keys.

filesystem_drivers.description: List of UEFI filesystem driver files (e.g., btrfs_x64.efi, zfs_x64.efi) to load for non-NTFS/FAT filesystems.

font_path.description: Path (relative or absolute) to a UEFI-compatible font (e.g., DejaVuSansB12.pf2). Required for custom UI fonts.

scan_all.description: Enable scanning for all boot loaders in all ESP subdirectories (including non-standard paths).

scan_windows.description: Enable scanning for Microsoft Windows boot loader (Bootmgfw.efi, etc.).

refind_public_key_file.description: Filename (including extension) of rEFInd's public key used in sbverify examples and MOK enrollment.
